title: Connect Instagram to ChatGPT: Analyze Your Account with AI

slides.title: Connect Instagram *to ChatGPT.*
slides.sub: Turn your Instagram data into smarter content decisions.

slides.title: Stop Guessing. *Start Analyzing.*
slides.text: AI can help you interpret the metrics your connection makes available.
slides.watch: Every number here is illustrative demo data, not a real account.

slides.title: Connect *Instagram.*
slides.lede: Ootto is a third-party connector. Connect only accounts you manage.

steps.d: Business or Creator, through Instagram’s own authorization screen

slides.watch: Review the permissions on Instagram’s screen before you approve.

slides.title: Connect *Ootto to ChatGPT.*
steps: In ChatGPT, open the custom MCP setup
Paste the URL as the Server URL
Keep OAuth, then sign in to Ootto
slides.watch: Custom MCP needs a supported ChatGPT plan, and menus change. See OpenAI’s help page.
slides.src: Source: Ootto setup guide · OpenAI help center

slides.title: Ask ChatGPT to *analyze your account.*
slides.prompt: Analyze the Instagram metrics available through my connected account. Identify my best-performing posts, engagement patterns, and content opportunities. Use real data only and clearly identify missing metrics.
slides.watch: Ask it to name any metric it cannot see.

slides.title: Find Your *Winning Content.*
slides.text: Questions your available analytics can help answer:
slides.watch: Answers depend on the metrics your connection exposes. Ask ChatGPT what is missing.

slides.title: From Data to *Better Content.*
slides.prompt: Based on my available Instagram analytics, create a 14-day content plan. Recommend topics, hooks, formats, and measurable goals. Explain the evidence behind each recommendation.
slides.watch: No tool guarantees growth. Treat every plan as a test.
